comment: Organ triage owner map + calibration thresholds (card #1073, rulings #1413; card #1685). DATA, not code: the router reads this file and contains no owner or threshold literals. The shipped map names NO peer: an operator adds organ owners in a local owner map (--owners-file, $SWARPH_TRIAGE_OWNERS_FILE or operator.json "triage_owners_file"), which deep-merges over this file, e.g. {"owners": {"security": {"owner": "<peer>"}}}. An organ with no entry routes to the default owner ($SWARPH_ESCALATION_TARGET or operator.json "escalation_target") and is counted; with no default owner configured it is counted and routed nowhere. Thresholds are written by a PROVEN calibration; until an organ has one, every model result for it is split. Owners keyed here route to '<owner> triage' rows. project_id is the board project triage-row cards are created under (BoardCardCreate requires it; #1446).

stuck-work.note: per-item blocking holder; unresolvable or non-peer blocker routes to the default owner and is counted
